description: Local Chromium slot-reuse research, round 2. Delay values are ms; cumulative raw delay counters are seconds. Raw reports and full RTP headers remain in the listed target directories.
scope: Built web app, real Rust SFU/native engine, virtual capture/output, loopback UDP relay. Shared macOS host; no concurrent builds or tests during successful measurements. No physical output, other browsers, internet voice path or TeamSpeak connection.
